title: Rebuild or refactor: what to do with an aging legacy system

points.heading: "Legacy" isn't about age
points.body: A system isn't legacy because it's old.

points.heading: When refactoring is the right answer
points.body: Refactoring means changing how the software is built without changing what it does: add tests first, break up the modules everything depends on, replace dead dependencies, move to a support…

points.heading: When a rebuild is the honest answer
points.body: Sometimes the foundation is the problem, and no amount of tidying fixes it.
